analysis:
MARKET & PORTFOLIO REVIEW (2026-07-29): Market regime is MIXED — SPY is marginally below its SMA50 (-0.7%) with a modestly positive 20d slope. This is not a high-conviction environment for adding risk aggressively; selectivity is paramount.

EXISTING POSITIONS:
• A (+7.55%): In uptrend-extending mode per screened data. Carry the position but watch for distribution signs above $145; tighten mental stop toward $125.
• AMP (+5.00%): Modest gain, not in screened candidate list so I cannot fully re-evaluate, but the position is small and within normal parameters. Hold.
• CI (+1.64%): Small gain, thesis intact. Not in screened list but position is within tolerance. Hold.
• FDS (+9.30%): Already in the screened list as an uptrend-basing setup at fair valuation. Position is profitable; let it run toward prior highs. No need to add — concentration would increase materially.
• LII (-7.74%): THIS IS THE CONCERN. LII is the only holding NOT appearing in the screened candidate list (which requires no confirmed downtrend). A -7.74% loss from entry and absence from the quality+trend screen is a meaningful thesis-break signal. Stop at avg $575.57 less ~12% structural stop puts hard floor around ~$506. Current price $531 is above that, but downside momentum + failing trend filter = tighten stop to ~$505-510 range (roughly 2x ATR below current) and be prepared to exit if that level breaks. Do not average down.

NEW TRADE CANDIDATES: Only one setup passes all filters with genuine asymmetry — ROP (Roper Technologies). It is a high-quality serial software acquirer trading at a 15.6x trailing / 16.2x fwd P/E, which is unusually cheap for a business with 27.7% operating margins, $2.3B FCF, and 8.5% revenue growth. It sits at just 25% of its 52-week range (Stage 1→2 basing territory), SMA50 slope is barely positive signalling the base is still being constructed rather than extended. Earnings are 85 days out (Oct 22), giving a clean runway. ATR-based stop produces a ~6.5% drawdown max — well within rules — and a reasonable target to $440 (prior resistance zone) delivers 2.6x risk/reward. Sized to risk 1.5% of equity, position fits within both the 25% concentration cap and the $31,903 headroom. WDAY is explicitly excluded given three consecutive stop-outs — the system has no edge there currently. VEEV and LMT are interesting but VEEV is 14.6% above SMA50 (extended for fresh entry) and LMT would push us to 6 positions in a MIXED tape. One high-conviction add is the right call; cash at 36% of equity is a feature, not a bug.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $375 or better; accept fills up to $378. Prefer entry on any intraday dip toward SMA50 support if market pulls back this week.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: Roper Technologies is a best-in-class serial acquirer of niche vertical software businesses. Fwd P/E of ~16x is well below the S&P median for a company with 27.7% operating margins, $2.3B annual FCF, and consistent mid-to-high single digit organic revenue growth. Analyst EPS revisions ticked up +1.0% in the past 60 days. The balance sheet (D/E 60) is conservatively managed. This is a 'wonderful business at a fair price' setup — Roper rarely trades this cheaply on a forward earnings basis. TECHNICAL: Price sits at just 25% of its 52-week range ($313-$558), consistent with a Stage 1 base building toward Stage 2 breakout. UPTREND (basing) classification is confirmed. SMA50 slope is barely positive (+0.2%) — this is the early inflection where Weinstein's 'basing knife' philosophy applies best. The stock is +10.8% vs SMA50, which is modestly extended but acceptable for a basing pattern. Earnings October 22 give 85 days of clean runway for the thesis to develop before binary event risk.
trades.exit_plan: Stop: hard stop at $350.72 (1.75x ATR below entry); trail stop up as price advances. Thesis-break conditions: SMA50 slope turns negative for two consecutive weeks; acquisition announced at a materially dilutive price; forward estimates revised down >5% in a single quarter. Time stop: reassess if price has not made progress toward $410 within 10 weeks of entry. Pre-earnings lightening: consider trimming 30-40% of position by Oct 15 to reduce binary earnings risk if position is sitting at a gain.
